pages.text: Peanuts can be found in Jungle biomes as Wild Peanuts.
Pine Nuts can be found in Taiga biomes in the leaves of certain Spruce trees.
Hazelnuts can be found in Birch Forest biomes in the leaves of certain Birch trees.
Almonds can be found in either Flower Forests or Sunflower Plains growing on a Blossoming Almond Tree with decorative pink leaves.
